newsitem.title: USA: Grow Biz to buy Video Game Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Grow Biz to buy Video Game Exchange.

text.p: Grow Biz International Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Video Game Exchange, based in Cleveland.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The transaction is subject to the negotiation of a definitive purchase agreement.
Video Game Exchange operate 40 video game stores in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Georgia and Maryland.

Grow Biz said the stores will be the center of a national chain of franchised store called "It's About Games," buying, selling and trading video, computer and other games at roughly half retail price. It said several new prototype stores will open in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area this summer.
Grow Biz is a retailer of used merchandise.
